alt: This document details a patient's medical journey from August 13, 2025, to October 29, 2025, involving buprenorphine-naloxone prescriptions from Dr. Brandon Manibog, Dr. Mitchell Goldstein, and Dr. Inderpreet Virk (4-1mg Film, 7, 10, 15-day supplies), multiple rejections from Tarzana Clinic and American Health Services for buprenorphine programs due to poly-abuse (Alprazolam), a seizure incident on August 28 or 29, 2025 after a self-initiated benzodiazepine taper, and difficulties in obtaining assistance for Alprazolam tapering despite multiple medical encounters including ER visits and primary care at Bartz-Altadonna.

$ 08/13/2025 – Buprenorphine-nalox 4-1mg Film / 2x Day (7 Day Supply) DR. BRANDON MANIBOG

$ Attempted Buprenorphine program at TARZANA CLINIC (PALMDALE)

$ 1st appointment – Counselor forgot to call to reschedule my appointment, doctor was not there

$ 2nd appointment – Was told that I would be dropped from program due to POLY-ABUSE ISSUE
(ALPRZOLAM) – REFUSED TO PROVIDE HELP WITH BENZO TAPER

$ 08/24/2025 – Buprenorphine-nalox 4-1mg Film / 2x Day (10 Day Supply) DR. MITCHELL GOLDSTEIN

$ 08/28 or 08/29 – Came to PALMDALE REGIONAL after passing out because of seizure (do not
remember, was told [REDACTED] after attempting BENZO TAPER MYSELF. After given
IV ATIVAN and running scans, the doctor on duty SHRUGGED HIS SHOULDERS AND SAID “THERE’S
NOTHING I CAN DO” AND DISCHARGED ME EVEN THOUGH I STILL HAD SHAKING/TREMORS WITH
NO RESOURCES/INFORMATION FOR HELP.

* FORCED TO GO BACK ON ALPRAZOLAM SO I WOULD NOT SEIZE THE NEXT DAY *

$ 09/12/2025 – Buprenorphine-nalox 4-1mg Film / 2x Day (10 Day Supply) DR. INDERPREET VIRK

$ Last prescription was via telehealth with PSYCHIATRIST at BRAIN HEALTH USA. Was told over
phone intake that I would receive help with BENZO TAPER – REFUSED BECAUSE OF “STICKY
SITUATION” and “TOO MUCH OF A LIABILITY.”

$ Attempted Buprenorphine program at AMERICAN HEALTH SERVICES (PALMDALE) – CANNOT
PARTICIPATE IN PROGRAM WITH POLY-ABUSE ISSUE – REFUSED TO PROVIDE HELP WITH BENZO
TAPER – TOLD TO VISIT PRIMARY

$ HAD TO DO A RAPID TAPER AT HOME FROM 6MG ALPRAZOLAM – LAST DOSE 9/23/2025

$ 9/25/2025 ER VISIT: Doctor on duty wrote my prescription incorrectly and put 4mg once daily /
15 day supply

$ PRIMARY CARE – OCTOBER 3RD AT BARTZ – ALTADONNA (PALMDALE)

Did not help at all. I explained my prescription runs out soon. Said to keep going to the ER to
continue getting temporary Suboxone prescriptions until I can talk to the MD on 10/29/2025.
